company.shortDescription: Enqaz is a tech-enabled company provide all road services to car owners through our mobile application like UBER
company.description: EnQaz is our nationwide, 24/7, on-demand, roadside assistance app. No membership dues, no hidden fees, no waiting on the phone. Just up-front flat-rate pricing due only when service is complete. EnQaz provides fast and efficient tow trucks for on-demand jump starts, tire changes, towing, lockouts, gas delivery (out of gas). It’s just like Uber, only for roadside assistance.
